steps.action: Send all six starting villagers to sheep.
Use the next two villagers for a House and Mining Camp.
Put both new villagers on gold.
Rally four more villagers to sheep for ten on food.

subtasks.action: Rally four more villagers to sheep for ten on food.
Build the Abbey of Kings with three from sheep.

steps.action: Place a Lumber Camp. Add a House before Feudal.
Rally to wood until eight villagers are chopping.
Use the Abbey builders for a Mill and three Farms. Add an Archery Range and Barracks.
Train Longbowmen and Spearmen. Add Farms and a Blacksmith with spare wood.
Build a House and start with six on sheep.
Send the first two new villagers to gold.
Rally back to sheep for eight on food.
Send the next villager to stone.
Have the next villager build a Lumber Camp.
Add three more miners for four on stone.
Start the Abbey with three from food. Split the others between wood and stone.
Reach six on wood while the Abbey goes up.
After aging up, send the builders to wood. Place the second TC once the wood and stone are ready.
With both TCs running, build up to 13 on food and seven on gold.
Start the White Tower when you can afford it. Add a Monastery and production in Castle Age.
Start six on sheep. Bring sheep home with the Scout and locate enemy gold.
Send the first new villager to sheep.
Use the next villager to build a House and Mining Camp.
Bring gold to three miners with new villagers.
Add four more villagers to sheep before aging up.
Build the School of Cavalry with five sheep gatherers.
Rebuild the food count to ten while the School goes up.
Train Royal Knights in Feudal. Send two builders to gold and use the other three for a House and Lumber Camp.
Put the three builders to work chopping wood.
Move eight to deer with a Mill once the first Knight is out. Add a Stable or Archery Range based on the enemy defense.

builds.name: School of Cavalry into two TCs

steps.action: Send all six starting villagers and the first new one to sheep.
Build a House and Mining Camp with the next villager.
Reach four on gold.
At 200 banked gold, move the miners to a Lumber Camp.
Reach ten on sheep and four on wood.
Start the School of Cavalry with two from sheep. Send four more to set up a stone Mining Camp.
Rally new villagers to wood until seven.
Rally the next villagers to stone until seven, then switch the rally back to sheep.
With the wood and stone ready, move seven miners and a woodcutter to the second TC site. Build once Feudal completes.
Return the School builders to sheep. Add a Stable if the position allows it.
Send all eight TC builders to gold once they finish.
Rally both TCs to food and start Royal Knight production.
Split the opening between three on sheep and three on gold.
Add the next villager to gold, then rally new villagers to sheep.
Inspire the miners with the Prelate and build a House before hitting the population cap.
Build Aachen Chapel near wood and gold with two villagers.
Gather wood for houses and an Outpost if your gold is exposed. Put a Prelate in Aachen Chapel.
Bring gold to at least five miners.
Build up to twelve on food and six on gold for Castle Age.
Build Burgrave Palace with six. Return them to food afterward and start production from the palace.
Start three on sheep and three on gold. Use one gold worker for the Mining Camp and House.
Rally to sheep for nine on food before pulling builders.

subtasks.action: Rally to sheep for nine on food before pulling builders.
Use four from food to build Aachen by the woodline with room for Farms.

steps.action: Use one villager for a Lumber Camp and House while aging up.
Build up to ten on wood and switch the rally to sheep.

subtasks.action: Build up to ten on wood and switch the rally to sheep.
In Feudal, garrison the Prelate in Aachen and research Double Broadax.

steps.action: Bring the food count to five.

subtasks.action: Bring the food count to five.
Add a Berry Mill and an Outpost if the matchup calls for one.

steps.action: Use spare wood for Farms in Aachen range. Add production based on what you scouted.
Set the TC by wood and stone. Use one villager to build the Ovoo.
Put five on a nearby straggler tree.
At 150 wood, move three choppers to sheep and set up a Ger for the other two at gold.
Keep two miners on gold and rally new villagers to sheep.
Build Deer Stones with four from sheep. Put a Stable in Ovoo range.
Rally to wood for an initial target of seven choppers.
Add a Pasture and start Keshik production from the Stable.
Finish building up to ten on wood.
Switch the rally to gold. Add Pastures and a Blacksmith. Prepare for the Steppe Redoubt if you're heading to Castle Age.

builds.name: Deer Stones into a second TC

steps.action: Start five on a straggler tree and use the sixth for an Ovoo. Move them to sheep afterward.
Rally new villagers to sheep until you have nine.
Rally to gold until you have four miners.
Start Deer Stones with two. Once you have 75 gold after paying for the age-up, shift the miners to wood.
In Feudal, move the landmark builders to sheep. Bank wood for a second TC and build it with the woodcutters.
Settle at eight on food, eight on wood and four on gold.
Add a production building in Ovoo range. Use double production and raid with the first groups.

builds.name: Song Dynasty into a second TC

steps.action: Build a Mill by the TC and gather sheep there. Use the first two new villagers to build a House and start mining gold.

subtasks.action: Build a Mill by the TC and gather sheep there. Use the first two new villagers to build a House and start mining gold.
Get two villagers onto gold.
Send five more villagers to sheep for eleven on food.

steps.action: Build the Imperial Academy with five from sheep. Return them to food when it finishes.
Start on nearby trees and build up to seven woodcutters.

subtasks.action: Start on nearby trees and build up to seven woodcutters.
Train Imperial Officials. Supervise the Mill, collect taxes, and place a Lumber Camp.

steps.action: Complete Song with the Barbican of the Sun using both miners. Send six sheep gatherers to a stone Mining Camp.

subtasks.action: Complete Song with the Barbican of the Sun using both miners. Send six sheep gatherers to a stone Mining Camp.
Send both Barbican builders to stone for eight miners.

steps.action: Once you have the resources, build the second TC with all eight stone miners. Send them back to food afterward.
Send the starting six to food and build a Berry Mill. Use a new villager for a House.
Set two new villagers to mine gold.
Rally to sheep until eleven villagers are on food.

subtasks.action: Rally to sheep until eleven villagers are on food.
Build the Imperial Academy with five sheep gatherers.

steps.action: While the landmark goes up, rally one villager to sheep to get back to seven on food.
Train Imperial Officials and move the landmark builders to wood. Add a Village and Lumber Camp.
Build up to ten on wood for production.

subtasks.action: Build up to ten on wood for production.
Build and supervise a Stable, then train Scouts and research Professional Scouts. Secure deer and add military production.

steps.action: Put five on wood. Use one villager for a Mill and House and the first new villager for a Mosque. Move the woodcutters to berries after dropping 50 wood.
Queue early upgrades and build a gold Mining Camp.
Rally new villagers to gold for three miners.
Add two villagers to sheep for ten on food.
Start the Tower of Victory with two from sheep. Move five from berries to wood and build a Lumber Camp.
Fill wood to eight villagers, then switch the rally to berries.
Add a Barracks, Stable and Archery Range as resources allow. Train Spearmen and Ghazi Raiders.
Rally new villagers until fourteen are on food.

subtasks.action: Rally new villagers until fourteen are on food.
For sustained pressure, rally to wood. Garrison a Scholar in the range and contest Sacred Sites with Sanctity.

steps.action: Open with five woodcutters. Use the first builders for a Mosque, Mill and House. Move to berries after dropping 100 wood.
Reach eight villagers on food.
Set up three gold miners for Feudal and Scholars.
Age up with four builders and rally to wood. Add a House and a stone Mining Camp.
Bring wood to nine villagers.
Send the four landmark builders to stone after aging up. Add a Blacksmith when affordable.
Add more miners for eight on stone.
When wood and stone are ready, use the eight miners to build a TC by deer.
With both TCs, aim for thirteen each on food and wood.
Add Stables and Archery Ranges. Train Ghazis and Archers and contest Sacred Sites.
Start five on berries. Use the other villager for a House and House of Wisdom, then send them to gold.
Rally to berries for seven on food.

subtasks.action: Rally to berries for seven on food.
Add two miners for three on gold.
Rally back to food until you can pull five and leave six gathering.

steps.action: Pick the Administrative Wing at the House of Wisdom.

subtasks.action: Pick the Administrative Wing at the House of Wisdom.
Shift five berry gatherers to wood.

steps.action: In Feudal, research Fresh Foodstuffs and Double Broadax. Build a Stable.
Build up to ten on food and eight on wood to support Horsemen.
Research Horticulture and add two production buildings. Reach Golden Age and adapt your army to the opponent.

builds.name: Military Wing into a second TC

steps.action: Start on berries with a Mill and House. The first new villager builds the House of Wisdom and goes to sheep.
Settle at seven gathering food.
Build a Mining Camp on gold.

subtasks.action: Build a Mining Camp on gold.
Rally three new villagers to gold.

steps.action: Rally back to sheep until nine are on food.

subtasks.action: Rally back to sheep until nine are on food.
Pick Military Wing. Leave the berry gatherers in place and shift the rest to wood. Build a stone Mining Camp.

steps.action: Move all three gold miners to stone.
Reach Feudal, build a Stable, and add the buildings needed for Golden Age. Research Fresh Foodstuffs.
Rally to wood until eleven are chopping.
Train Horsemen. Build the second Town Center once the wood and stone are ready.
Start with all six on sheep.
Build two Hunting Cabins and a House. Scout for deer.
Get seven villagers back onto food.
Use five from deer to build the Kremlin.
Leave four on food. Move the rest to straggler trees and rally to eight on wood.
In Feudal, use the landmark builders for a Stable and then deer. Rally new villagers to sheep.
When the straggler trees run out, send seven woodcutters to gold.
Train a few Knights to harass while saving for the Abbey of the Trinity. In Castle Age, train Warrior Monks to collect relics.
Send four villagers to straggler trees. Keep two free to build.
Start two Hunting Cabins and add a third with the first new villager. Build a House after the opening wood.
Gather with eight on sheep.

subtasks.action: Gather with eight on sheep.
Train Scouts from the cabins.

steps.action: Start the Golden Gate with five villagers.
Shift six villagers to straggler trees and rally new villagers to sheep.
As Feudal comes in, bring the split to twelve on food and six on wood.
Research Professional Scouts and add Scouts. Bring in two deer packs and spend wood on military production.

builds.name: Military Schools into a Sipahi timing

steps.action: Open with a House and split across food, wood, gold and stone. Rally the first new villagers to sheep.
Reach six on food, three on wood, and one miner each on gold and stone.

subtasks.action: Reach six on food, three on wood, and one miner each on gold and stone.
Build the first Military School. Add a House before aging up.

steps.action: Rally new villagers to food until twelve.

subtasks.action: Rally new villagers to food until twelve.
Start the Feudal landmark with four food gatherers. Shift four more to wood and rally to the woodline.

steps.action: Reach ten woodcutters during the transition.

subtasks.action: Reach ten woodcutters during the transition.
In Feudal, move the stone miner to gold and add another Military School.

steps.action: Rebuild to twelve on food and reach three on gold.

subtasks.action: Rebuild to twelve on food and reach three on gold.
Add another Military School and group Sipahis with a Mehter. Then build up gold for the next transition.

steps.action: Open with six on sheep.
Use the first new villager for a House and Mining Camp.
Send both early villagers to gold.
Rally back to sheep until eleven are on food.
Use both gold miners for the Twin Minaret Medrese. Set up camps for four on wood and three on stone.
Use a woodcutter for the next House. Alternate between wood and stone while aging up.
Bring wood to nine and stone to five.
In Feudal, return the two landmark builders to sheep. Use the nine woodcutters to build the second TC by wood.
Add two Military Schools, a Blacksmith and Sipahis. Rally both TCs to food.
Build up to thirteen on food.

subtasks.action: Build up to thirteen on food.
Move all five stone miners to gold and keep up pressure while the economy grows.

steps.action: Start with five on nearby wood. Use the sixth villager for a Pit Mine and surround it with Houses.
Send the first new villager to a second tree. Gather wood before switching the group to food.
Build up to twelve on food before aging up.

subtasks.action: Build up to twelve on food before aging up.
Use four food gatherers to build Mansa Quarry. Chop 50 wood from nearby trees for a Lumber Camp. Add a second Pit Mine.

steps.action: Rally new villagers until ten are on wood.
Use two woodcutters for a Stable. Add the second Stable with two more when you have the wood.
Bring food to nineteen using new villagers and woodcutters.
Train Sofas. Add a Mill and cattle to sustain production, then Archery Ranges against Spearmen.
Put five on nearby wood before switching to sheep. Use the sixth villager for the Pit Mine and surrounding Houses.
Rally new villagers to sheep for twelve on food.
Build Mansa Quarry with three from sheep. Move five more to nearby trees.
Send two new villagers to gold.
Build a Lumber Camp before rallying more villagers to the woodline.
Reach ten on wood. Return the landmark builders to sheep.
Once the wood is ready, use eight woodcutters to build the second TC. Defend with a Barracks or Archery Range and choose between cattle and saving for Castle Age.
Start on berries with a Mill. Use one starting villager for a Cistern and House.
Use the first new villager to build a gold Mining Camp.
Reach two on gold and switch the rally back to sheep.
Build up to eleven on food before aging up.

subtasks.action: Build up to eleven on food before aging up.
Start the Imperial Hippodrome with five from sheep. Bank gold for the Limitanei upgrade and switch the miners to wood.

steps.action: Train Horsemen in Feudal. Build a House, Lumber Camp and Mercenary House.
Rally to wood until eight villagers are chopping.
Add a Barracks and another Cistern. Hire Longbowmen and take another berry patch.
Bring gold up to four miners.
After the Feudal timing, shift the economy to food and gold. Age up with the Golden Horn Tower and add Cataphracts and a Monastery.
Open with three on food, one on gold, one on stone and a builder for the Cistern and House. Set up Mining Camps at both veins.
Send two more villagers to stone.
Rally to sheep for eight gatherers, then switch new villagers to wood.
Start the Grand Winery with four food gatherers. Expand the network to five Cisterns.
In Feudal, switch sheep gatherers to berries and return the network builder to stone.
Reach nine on wood and four on stone.
With the resources ready, use four miners and four woodcutters for the second TC.
Once the TC is up, return to eleven on wood and build up to eleven on food.
Keep one on stone and adjust both rallies based on available berries and enemy pressure.

builds.name: Uma Bannerman with Horsemen and Yumi

steps.action: Start three on food, one on gold and two on stone.
Rally new villagers until ten are on food.

subtasks.action: Rally new villagers until ten are on food.
Start the Kura Storehouse with four villagers near the woodline.

steps.action: Leave four on food and reach six on wood.
Once you bank the stone for Daimyo Manor, move both stone miners to gold and research it.
Send the landmark builders to wood as Feudal comes in and reach twelve woodcutters.
Build a Stable and Archery Range for an Uma Bannerman, Horsemen and Yumi. Switch new villagers back to food.

builds.name: Dark Age Spearmen into Fast Castle

steps.action: Open on sheep and wood with one villager building a Barracks. Use that villager for a Farmhouse by berries and train two Spearmen.
Rally to sheep for five on food.
Research Towara and have a woodcutter build the Forge by gold.
Move the Forge builder and two sheep gatherers to gold.
Shift sheep gatherers to berries once Towara finishes. Add another Farmhouse and build Kura with two from food.
Shift two from food to gold for five miners.
Send both Kura builders to gold when they finish.
Age up with the Floating Gate using eight sheep gatherers.
Shift five sheep gatherers to wood.
In Castle Age, use the builders for a Stable. Train Mounted Samurai and use the Shinto Priest's Yorishiro.
Start five on sheep. Scout for nearby deer.
Build a Mining Camp and House. Set up a Deer Mill and research Survival Techniques.
Rally the first villagers until three are on gold.
Start Aachen Chapel with three from food.
Rally three new villagers to wood, then switch back to food.
In Feudal, return the builders to food and gold. Set up a Lumber Camp and add another House.
Build up to ten on food and five on gold.
Use eight food gatherers for Burgrave Palace. In Castle Age, add a Monastery, Prelates and Gilded Spearmen.
Send all five starting villagers to sheep.
Send the first two new villagers to gold.
Rally back to sheep until eight are on food.

subtasks.action: Rally back to sheep until eight are on food.
Start Aachen Chapel with two villagers when you can afford it.

steps.action: Assign four to stone and leave four on food. Rally new villagers to wood.
At half progress on Aachen, move one builder to wood.
Bring the woodline to seven villagers to fund the TC.

subtasks.action: Bring the woodline to seven villagers to fund the TC.
Build the second TC with at least eight villagers when the wood and stone are ready. Secure the expansion before investing in Castle Age.

steps.action: Build a Mill with all five starting villagers and bring sheep there. Supervise with the Imperial Official.
Use the seventh villager to build a Village.

subtasks.action: Use the seventh villager to build a Village.
Reach seven on sheep.

steps.action: Rally three new villagers to gold.
Collect taxes and use a sheep gatherer to start Jiangnan Tower. Shift three from food to wood and add a Lumber Camp.
Rally new villagers to wood until six.
In Feudal, place Archery Ranges near the Tower and select City Guard. Add a Barracks as needed.
Build up to eight on food and nine on wood.
Train Zhuge Nu and add a Blacksmith. Build up wood and gold, raid with the first group, and prepare Rams if you can sustain the pressure.
Build a Mill under the TC with five and bring sheep there. Assign the Official to supervise. Use the first two new villagers for a House and Mining Camp.
Send both builders to mine gold.
Rally to food until nine before pulling the landmark builder.

subtasks.action: Rally to food until nine before pulling the landmark builder.
Start Jiangnan Tower with one villager and leave room for military buildings. Put up a Lumber Camp.

steps.action: Leave five on food and move the rest to wood until six are chopping.
In Feudal, build a Stable near the Tower and research Professional Scouts. Train Scouts to bring in deer.
Once you bring in deer, shift four from food to wood for ten choppers.
Adapt production to the enemy army. To age up, shift to food and gold and build Mount Lu Academy.
Send five to sheep. Use Jeanne for a House and Mining Camp, then send her to gold.
Rally new villagers to sheep for eight on food.
Bring gold to three miners before moving Jeanne.
Send one more villager to sheep.
Build the School of Cavalry with Jeanne and one from food. Add a Mill, research Wheelbarrow and set up a Lumber Camp.
During the age-up, assign three to wood and four to gold.
Train Royal Knights. Use the first Consecrate on the School when it becomes available.
Bring wood to five villagers.
Add gold miners and use an Archery Range or Barracks as the matchup demands. Transition to Castle Age when you have room.
Start two on sheep and three on wood. Use Jeanne for a House, Mill and Mining Camp. Move the woodcutters to sheep once the opening wood is banked.
Reach seven on food before rallying to gold.
Bring gold to four miners.
Send three new villagers to sheep.

subtasks.action: Send three new villagers to sheep.
Start the School of Cavalry with Jeanne and one sheep gatherer. Set up a Lumber Camp and another House.

steps.action: Bring wood to five using three from sheep and two more villagers.
Research Professional Scouts and train Royal Knights. Add Scouts and secure deer with an Outpost and Mill as needed.
Consecrate the School and balance food and gold for Knights. Prepare the Royal Institute when you can go to Castle Age.

builds.name: Culture Wing into a fast second TC

steps.action: Start five on sheep. Use the sixth villager for the House of Wisdom, House and stone Mining Camp.
Send the first two new villagers to separate trees.
Rally the next three to stone for four miners.
Select Advancement from Culture Wing. Shift one from sheep to wood and rally the next villagers there.
Reach seven on wood.
Once you have the resources, use four miners and five woodcutters to build the second TC. Rally new villagers back to food.
Use scouting to decide whether to add defensive production or use your economic lead for Castle Age.

builds.name: Reinforcements and double Stable into Castle

steps.action: Send four to berries. The other two build a Mill and join them. Have the first two new villagers build a Mining Camp and House.
Send both early villagers to gold.
Build the House of Wisdom. Add one miner and more sheep gatherers.

subtasks.action: Build the House of Wisdom. Add one miner and more sheep gatherers.
Reach nine on food and three on gold.

steps.action: Select Reinforcements from Military Wing. Move three from sheep to wood and set up a Lumber Camp.
Bring the split to eight woodcutters and five gold miners.
Harass with Desert Raiders and build a Stable. Add Houses for Golden Age and a second Stable.
If you can leave Feudal, shift to food and gold and take Culture Wing Logistics. In Castle Age, add Camel Lancers and Mosques.
Start all six villagers on sheep.

subtasks.action: Start all six villagers on sheep.
Build a House and set up access to gold.
Put the first two new villagers on gold.

steps.action: Rally back to sheep for eleven on food.

subtasks.action: Rally back to sheep for eleven on food.
Choose the Hospitallers for Feudal.

steps.action: Leave three on food and shift the rest to wood for ten choppers.
Research Safe Passage. Add a Mill, Barracks, Archery Range and Blacksmith as resources allow.
Train Spearmen, Archers and a few Hospitaller Knights. Take Blacksmith upgrades before pressing the attack.
Start with six on food.

subtasks.action: Start with six on food.
Use the first new villagers for a House and Mining Camp.

steps.action: Assign two villagers to gold.
Rally new villagers to wood and move both gold miners to stone. Choose the Principality of Antioch for Feudal.
Shift five food gatherers to reach eight on wood and five on stone.
In Feudal, research Safe Passage and shift three woodcutters to stone.
Reach eight stone miners.
With the resources ready, use all eight miners for a second TC by deer. Add a Mill and research Survival Techniques.
After construction, send the builders to deer and reach twelve on food.
Add two Barracks for Serjeants. Choose the Kingdom of Castile in Castle Age and add Archery Ranges for Genitours.
Start six on sheep.

subtasks.action: Start six on sheep.
Build a House in range of the TC.

steps.action: Rally three new villagers to gold. Send the next one to sheep.
At 200 gold, use three miners and two sheep gatherers for the Abbey. Put one on wood and rally the next two to stone.
Reach six on wood and two on stone.
Once stone and wood are ready, use six woodcutters and two Abbey builders for a Manor. Train the Lord of Lancaster.
Settle at eight on wood and return three builders to gold.
Add two production buildings. Mix Hobelars, Yeomen or Spearmen to suit the matchup and add a Blacksmith.
Send six villagers to sheep.

subtasks.action: Send six villagers to sheep.
Build a House near the TC.

steps.action: Send the first three new villagers to gold.
Start the Abbey with the three miners and two from sheep. Put one on wood and two on stone.
Reach five on wood while keeping two stone miners.
Use five woodcutters for a Manor when you can afford it. Move stone miners to sheep and Abbey builders to gold.
Rally new villagers to sheep for thirteen on food.

subtasks.action: Rally new villagers to sheep for thirteen on food.
Switch the rally to gold until you have ten miners.

steps.action: Build the White Tower with the miners. Build up wood and then add a Stable, Monastery and Farms.
Open with a Barracks and three villagers on straggler trees. Rally new villagers to sheep.
Bank the opening wood for Gers and move the woodcutters to sheep.
Reach nine on food.

subtasks.action: Reach nine on food.
Send Kharash to enemy gold. Set up a Ger at gold and another at deer. Build the Golden Tent too.

steps.action: Rally new villagers to gold until three are mining.
Build up wood to five villagers.

subtasks.action: Build up wood to five villagers.
Choose Khan and Torguuds for the transition. Move the miners to wood with a Ger and prepare Spearmen.

steps.action: Reach eleven woodcutters to sustain production.
Upgrade Spearmen in Feudal and place an Ovoo. Use cavalry to pressure exposed resources.

builds.name: Khan and Torguuds into two TCs

steps.action: Open with sheep, a Ger, an Ovoo and the Golden Tent. Then send the three builders to gold.
Put three villagers on gold.

subtasks.action: Put three villagers on gold.
Move the miners to food after banking 200 gold.

steps.action: Reach eleven on food. Then send new villagers to separate straggler trees.
Choose Khan and Torguuds for Feudal and shift six food gatherers to wood.
Keep adding woodcutters until there are sixteen.
Once you can afford it, build a second TC with your woodcutters. Use Khan and Torguuds to defend or harass.
After expanding, redistribute across food, wood and gold based on enemy pressure.
Start with six on food.

subtasks.action: Start with six on food.
Set up the Varangian Warcamp as you send the first new villagers to gold.

steps.action: Put two villagers on gold.
Reach eleven on food before pulling landmark builders.

subtasks.action: Reach eleven on food before pulling landmark builders.
Start the Imperial Hippodrome with four food gatherers. Shift one food gatherer and two miners to wood.

steps.action: Add woodcutters until eight are chopping.

subtasks.action: Add woodcutters until eight are chopping.
Train three or four Horsemen in Feudal. Build a House and return the builders to food.

steps.action: Shift five from wood to deer and build a Varangian Stronghold. Add another Stronghold and the Arsenal when you can.
Move villagers to gold until there are five miners.
Train Varangian Guards and research their upgrades. Group them with the Horsemen for the push.

builds.name: Hippodrome and Golden Horn toward Imperial

steps.action: Send the six starting villagers to food.
Use two new villagers to build the Varangian Warcamp and Mining Camp.
Put those two villagers on gold.
Rally the next villagers to sheep until you have ten on food before starting the landmark.

subtasks.action: Rally the next villagers to sheep until you have ten on food before starting the landmark.
Build the Hippodrome with four food gatherers and rally new villagers to wood.

steps.action: Send all four Hippodrome builders to gold when the landmark finishes.
Train Horsemen to support the Champion. Switch to deer and use two miners to build a Varangian Stronghold.
Use ten food gatherers to age up with the Golden Horn Tower. Add a Monastery and save food and gold for Imperial if the game gives you room.
Put two on wood and three on gold. The sixth villager builds the Matsuri and then mines. Rally new villagers to sheep.
Settle at four on gold and two on wood.

subtasks.action: Settle at four on gold and two on wood.
Buy wood at the Matsuri and place the first Yatai. Save gold for the second and send it toward deer.

steps.action: After the second Yatai, shift one woodcutter to sheep and one to gold. Research Towara.
Reach six on food and send the next villager to gold.
Reach six gold miners.

subtasks.action: Reach six gold miners.
Drop off gold and trade for wood to afford the third Yatai.

steps.action: Rally back to sheep for eight on food.
Use four food and three gold villagers for the Ryokan. Move the remaining food gatherers to wood. In Feudal, research Takezaiku and add the fourth Yatai.
Start two on wood and three on gold. Build the Matsuri with the last villager and then send them to gold.
Use the first new villager to build a Farmhouse by berries. Move one woodcutter to gold when the first tree is gone. Buy wood for the Yatai.
Reach seven on food and five on gold.

subtasks.action: Reach seven on food and five on gold.
After the third Yatai, bank gold for Towara and move all five miners to stone.

steps.action: Put all five to work mining stone.

subtasks.action: Put all five to work mining stone.
Research Towara and use four food gatherers for the Ryokan. Split the rest between wood and stone.
Reach ten woodcutters.

steps.action: In Feudal, research Takezaiku and build the second TC when you have the wood and stone.
Send villagers to berries and park the Worker Elephant nearby for drop-offs. Send the first new villager to berries.
Reach seven food gatherers.

subtasks.action: Reach seven food gatherers.
Use the second new villager for a House. Set up a Worker Elephant as the gold drop-off.

steps.action: Put three villagers on gold.
Start the Dome of the Faith with four from berries. Move food and gold villagers to straggler trees.
Reach four woodcutters, then rally new villagers back to sheep.
Use the landmark builders for a Stable, then return them to berries.
Train two Raider Elephants to pressure the opponent. Add a Healer Elephant to support them.
Add an Archery Range and Archers if the opponent counters with Spearmen.
Send six villagers to berries.

subtasks.action: Send six villagers to berries.
Place the first House with space for the future fort. Position the Worker Elephant to take drop-offs.

steps.action: Put the first two new villagers on gold.
Rally to food until there are ten gatherers.
Start the Tower of Victory with three from sheep. Move three from berries to wood and bring over a Worker Elephant.
Bring wood to five villagers.

subtasks.action: Bring wood to five villagers.
After saving gold, move the miners to stone. Add a House and Stable during the transition.

steps.action: Reach seven stone miners.
In Feudal, train a Raider Elephant and build Tughlaqabad Fort with three from food.
After setting up the fort and its stone upgrades, shift miners to gold for nine on gold.
Add Archery Ranges. Age up with the House of Learning and upgrade Elephants and Archers in Castle Age.
Send one Mounted Villager to reindeer and use the other two for the Mining Camp.

subtasks.action: Send one Mounted Villager to reindeer and use the other two for the Mining Camp.
Keep one on food and put both builders on gold.

steps.action: Rally four new villagers to food on reindeer or sheep.

subtasks.action: Rally four new villagers to food on reindeer or sheep.
Use one from sheep to build the Great Pasture. Move two food gatherers to wood and build a Lumber Camp and House.

steps.action: Reach two woodcutters and three gold miners.

subtasks.action: Reach two woodcutters and three gold miners.
In Feudal, research Mohe Ancestry. Add a Grassland and train Iron Pagodas.

steps.action: Assign more villagers until four are on wood and five are on gold.

subtasks.action: Assign more villagers until four are on wood and five are on gold.
Add a Stable for more production. Mix Mohe Tribesmen with the Iron Pagodas against Spearmen.

steps.action: Send one Mounted Villager to food and use the other two for the Mining Camp.

subtasks.action: Send one Mounted Villager to food and use the other two for the Mining Camp.
Keep one on food and put both builders on gold.

steps.action: Rally early villagers to food until there are four.
Once the age-up gold is ready, switch both miners to stone and build a camp. Train regular villagers for now.
Use one from food to build the Flower Pagoda. Move two to wood and add a House.
Build up to five on wood and keep two on stone.
Once the TC stone is banked, move both miners to wood. Use the Pagoda ability on food and wood if it reaches both.

subtasks.action: Once the TC stone is banked, move both miners to wood. Use the Pagoda ability on food and wood if it reaches both.
Reach seven on wood.

steps.action: With the wood and stone ready, build the second TC by deer. Resume Mounted Villager production when gold can support it.
Rally the second TC to deer. Build up wood for Feudal defense or gold to age up with the Dragon Pavilion.
Build a Longhouse by the TC. Start two woodcutters and rally new villagers to food.
Train two Bondi and harass enemy gold. Then set up a Mill at deer.
Assign six villagers to deer.
Bank 50 wood for a Mining Camp and shift the woodcutters to gold.

subtasks.action: Bank 50 wood for a Mining Camp and shift the woodcutters to gold.
Reach eight on food and five on gold.

steps.action: Age up with Baugr Fort. Move spare villagers to wood and return the builders to deer when they finish.
Reach six on wood and switch the rally back to food.
Start Hirdmen and Berserkers. Add Bondi against cavalry. Use Völur to contest Sacred Grove locations.
Reach ten food gatherers.
Build up gold and secure another deer source. If you can maintain pressure, add Barracks and infantry upgrades.
Place the first Longhouse beside the TC and leave room for another. Scout enemy gold and wood.
Bring food to six villagers.

subtasks.action: Bring food to six villagers.
Build a gold Mining Camp.
Assign two gold miners.

steps.action: When you can afford it, use the miners for Baugr Fort. Set up Lumber and stone Mining Camps.
Bank the stone for a second TC, then move the miners to wood.

subtasks.action: Bank the stone for a second TC, then move the miners to wood.
Reach sixteen woodcutters.

steps.action: When you can afford it, build a TC with seven to nine villagers. Prioritize safe wood and deer.
Add another Longhouse between the TCs. Invest in an army under pressure, or prioritize food and gold for Castle Age.
Send cattle to berries. Put two villagers on wood and use another for a Tower House behind the berries.

subtasks.action: Send cattle to berries. Put two villagers on wood and use another for a Tower House behind the berries.
Start two villagers chopping and rally new villagers to food.

steps.action: After banking 50 wood, build a gold Mining Camp and send the woodcutters and Tower House builder there.
Set three villagers to mine gold.
Buy cattle for berries and start the Stone of Destiny with four villagers. Shift food gatherers to wood.
Reach ten woodcutters.
In Feudal, train a Kirkman and place a Stable and Archery Range within the Stone's range. Place a Fishpond between food and wood.
Keep producing Horsemen and Archers. Add a second round of production buildings if your economy can support it.
Place a Tower House by berries and return its builder to sheep. Send cattle to berries.
Send the first two new villagers to straggler trees.
After banking the opening wood, return both to sheep. Build a gold Mining Camp.
Reach three gold miners.

subtasks.action: Reach three gold miners.
Train cattle for berries and rally new villagers to wood. Add a Lumber Camp.

steps.action: Build the Stone of Destiny with four from food. Send four more food gatherers and all three gold miners to a stone Mining Camp.

subtasks.action: Build the Stone of Destiny with four from food. Send four more food gatherers and all three gold miners to a stone Mining Camp.
Reach six on wood and seven on stone.

steps.action: In Feudal, place a second TC once the wood and stone are ready. Reassign the builders and keep both TCs running.
